risk_note: RV2 by path. A new worker-only ledger module writes asset_snapshots: first tick after 15 s, then every 60 s, for every app with ledger accounts, D is due at D+1 00:01 +08:00. No new queue, no new table: the row is its own completion mark. Backfill within a 7-day window, oldest first, stops the app at the first failed day; older gaps only log an error; an app with no rows gets only the newest due day. Unconfirmed rows are replayed before 00:30; after 00:30 only when event_log has no asset_snapshot.timed_out of that (app, D), matched by name, app and date (read-only query on a table ledger does not own, FU-EVENT-LOG-READ-PORT). The existing runner writes amounts and alerts, unchanged. ledger.advance_alert_fen unset means no alert (BR-FUND-20, D10-589 1); the key is registered by test-change B2-04zo, #2282. Missing EVENT_BUS refuses to start. No contract, no migration.
